products.name: Swim Level Handoff
products.product: A focused swim lesson level progression tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent swim schools and lesson programs
products.problem: Skill observations, confidence, instructor notes, class placement, and parent communication can diverge when students change instructors or terms.
products.valueProposition: Turns swim lesson level progression tracking into a visible operating queue so every level change has current observations, an instructor decision, and a communicated next placement.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets swim lesson level progression tracking software, swim lesson level progression tracking tracker, swim lesson level progression tracking template, and swim lesson level progression tracking checklist searches.

products.name: Make-Up Lesson Credit Desk
products.product: A focused swim school makeup lesson credit tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent swim schools and lesson programs
products.problem: Absence reasons, policy eligibility, credit expiry, class capacity, redemption, and cancellations are reconciled through front-desk messages.
products.valueProposition: Turns swim school makeup lesson credit tracking into a visible operating queue so every make-up request has a consistent eligibility decision and a traceable credit outcome.
